Extends the current two-hour opaque live session without changing media asset identity; stopped channels/streams are rejected. Media endpoint is /suxinvideo/live/media, outside the business API limiter. Public sources allow guests; a supplied APP bearer or website member session is validated. Member provider sources require an explicit member-ID whitelist per module, independently of VIP status. Upstream URLs and account secrets are never returned.

get.description: Shanghai-date EPG with Unix-second times, filtered by the same live source authorization as playback. Empty schedules contain items=[], now=null, next=null. A schedule does not create replay capability. Public sources allow guests; a supplied APP bearer or website member session is validated. Member provider sources require an explicit member-ID whitelist per module, independently of VIP status. Upstream URLs and account secrets are never returned.

post.description: Resolves an ended programme with actual upstream catchup capability. Returns mode=catchup/event_replay, programme_id, duration_ms and is_live=false; renew and opaque media revalidate the member/module whitelist or revocable subscription on every request. Retry the same programme once; never switch to a different event. Public sources allow guests; a supplied APP bearer or website member session is validated. Member provider sources require an explicit member-ID whitelist per module, independently of VIP status. Upstream URLs and account secrets are never returned.
